sacramento_scenarios.basis: Simultaneous design scenario:362 workplace users,4 shared hospitality attendees,120 learners,12 client visitors in A-L01 and 6 J2 visitors in B-L01 =504. Learners concentrate in C-L01; day D empty because residents move to program. These are anonymous attendance assumptions, not payroll or new hiring. Meeting and dining users move between rooms without multiplying people.
Separate night-residency capacity; does not add60 to daytime event.
R01 envelope held flat for five-year capacity planning; no authorized workforce growth.
R01 envelope held flat for ten-year capacity planning; future growth/transport/siting unresolved.

sacramento_economics.basis: Analyst synthetic allowances; not quotes, valuation, appropriations or construction contracts. Land, financing, tax, abnormal ground and offsite utility costs unknown and excluded, not zero. No offset against current finance allowance or payroll.

sacramento_phases.name: R01 visual baseline
sacramento_phases.dependency: Four buildings, ten floors, 362 workplaces and 60 single rooms. Approval records a planning design, not land tenure or construction.

sacramento_phases.name: R02 source and floor extensions
sacramento_phases.dependency: Retain the approved master and three reference floors. Seven other floors are explicitly modelled design extensions with fixed stacked cores.

sacramento_phases.name: Parcel and engineering
sacramento_phases.dependency: Supported parcel, tenure, utilities, accessibility, transport demand and civil/structural/fire engineering remain unresolved.

sacramento_phases.name: Procurement, construction and occupancy
sacramento_phases.dependency: No procurement, permit, construction, fit-out or occupancy date is asserted. Execution requires supported decisions and technical approvals.

sacramento_phases.name: 2031 and 2036 capacity review
sacramento_phases.dependency: Both planning horizons retain 362 fitted workplaces and 60 rooms. Future workforce growth and additional floor capacity are unknown; no future construction is implied.

sacramento_assumptions.statement: R01 controls four-building composition, dimensions and 362 workplaces/60 single rooms. Internal plans on seven remaining levels are explicit R02 design extensions, not accepted as-built conditions.
2026 actual company employment, campus assigned staff, shift attendance and construction dates remain unknown. Fitted staff workplaces and meeting/learning/dining/bed capacities never create people.
237J2 authorized billets include35 Education and 28HQ. JAG remains six five-person teams, not twelve staff from 12 touchdown desks. Full current named-person bridge preserved.
120 day learners is a simultaneous cap;48 resident cohort members are inside it. Residence has separate night capacity 60, including12 faculty/visitor rooms.
252 drawn parking bays precede accessible-bay conversion. Mode shares, transport demand and event overflow remain unresolved. Parking drawing is not a resolved supply-demand balance.
Primary production/Alexandria compute remains third-party colocation direction outside campus. A service rooms contain only local edge, communications and workplace support.

sacramento_conditional_workforce_compari.meaning: R01 floor labels repeat these conditional planning populations. They do not establish actual 2026 employees, daily campus attendance or assigned desks.
